scope: One fixed development realization of each required spike-count generator. Not a frozen validation bank, false-positive calibration, power analysis, independently validated replay or real-data association.
independent_verification: Reconstruct every fitted and oracle physical-lag endpoint, all event-order controls and every held-out prediction. Independently refit nuisance rates on the first fixed animal/pause bank per generator (12 chronological periods total). Other nuisance predictions are checked from saved means, not described as independently refitted.
zero_event_observation: First pause of the first animal has no synthetic event; keep all its pairs and both chronological RUN periods.
generating_covariates: Simulated circular RUN path with analytically consistent tangent direction and speed, and an 8 Hz theta reference. These are simulated covariates, not native LFP or measured behavior. PRE and POST trace the same path; their physical clocks remain separate.
generating_rates: Poisson immigrants with spatial, direction, speed and theta-dependent rates. Rate-only drift changes POST cell rates. Shared-theta input changes POST phase preferences, but all cells are conditionally independent given theta.
generating_coupling: For stable coordination, independently copy each immigrant spike to its successor with probability 0.4 and delay 20 ms in both periods. For the update generator, apply copying only in POST. Do not recursively copy descendants; known marginal means include expected copied spikes.
regression_to_mean: Independent PRE and POST populations; choose the synthetic event order from the PRE oracle-residual net directional coordination ranking. This makes event order depend on PRE measurement noise without any actual neural update. No POST spike affects event generation.
event_labels: Oracle synthetic sequence fixtures, not validation by the spatial decoder. Shuffles preserve whole population-bin vectors, totals, duration and participating units.
endpoint: Refit the existing guarded smooth Poisson nuisance model separately within PRE and POST on every generated count bank; calculate directional residual coordination and POST minus PRE. Also measure oracle-rate endpoints for diagnostics, never substitute them for fitted endpoints.
inference: Leave one complete animal out, retain all pauses and neuron pairs with hierarchical weights, control PRE coordination and rates, and refit baseline and augmented predictors for original and every shuffled event condition. Report numerical gains and slopes only; one development draw cannot establish null rejection rates.
